answer: The next events would carry total_amount and no amount, so every consumer that binds to the name amount gets null or fails. A rename is breaking in both directions (it is not backward or forward compatible unless the format supports aliases), so saying downstream will adapt is not safe. Required sequence is expand-migrate-contract: (1) Expand: producer writes both amount and total_amount while consumers keep reading amount, until both fields are on 100% of events for about 3 days. (2) Migrate: each listed consumer moves to total_amount until every consumer reads only the new field. (3) Contract: drop amount only after about 30 days with no reads of it, confirmed by query logs. Source: pa_pattern_schema_evolution.md, sections Forward and Backward Compatibility and Handling Breaking Changes.
